description: This file defines a Next.js page component for displaying details of a book, including fetching book data, generating metadata for SEO, and handling static parameters for static site generation.

methods.name: generateStaticParams
methods.description: Generates static parameters for each featured book to enable static site generation.

methods.name: generateMetadata
methods.description: Creates SEO metadata for a book page based on the book's data, including title, description, and Open Graph tags.

methods.name: BookPage
methods.description: Main React component that fetches and displays detailed information about a specific book.
